description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipDecorator class, which provides a decorator pattern implementation for the EmployeeMembership entity. It includes methods to set related Employee and Membership objects by ID, retrieve formatted subscription dates, and get the currency name associated with the membership.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for EmployeeMembership entity, facilitating setting related entities, retrieving formatted dates, and obtaining currency information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeMembership instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Protected method to access the wrapped EmployeeMembership entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity related to the membership based on employee number.

methods.name: setMembershipByMembershipId
methods.description: Sets the Membership entity related to the employee membership based on membership ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Retrieves the subscription commence date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Retrieves the subscription renewal date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getCurrencyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the currency associated with the subscription, if available.
